factors.name: full_symmetric_qk_sm120
factors.question: Can a native SM120 full/symmetric QK path reduce exact attention latency?

factors.name: qk_backward
factors.question: Does the exact tied-QK backward path avoid duplicate Q/K work without changing the VJP?

factors.name: dx_gemm_backend
factors.question: Can a native SM120 Dx GEMM improve the exact input projection?

factors.name: dy_gemm_backend
factors.question: Can a native SM120 Dy GEMM improve the exact read/write projection?

factors.name: dy_relu_epilogue_layout
factors.question: Can exact Dy + ReLU work stay in a GEMM epilogue/layout without changing values?

factors.name: e_gemm
factors.question: Can the exact E projection use a faster native SM120 GEMM path?

factors.name: checkpoint_policy
factors.question: Which exact recomputation boundary lowers memory without changing the training graph?

foldover.remaining_aliases: two-factor interactions remain grouped within their original three-term classes

next_round_handoff.interaction_round: construct a full 2^k factorial over the selected factors; do not infer aliased interactions from L8
next_round_handoff.method: fit main effects with block/position covariates; preserve alias uncertainty
next_round_handoff.promotion_rule: only exact-oracle-passing, memory-safe factors with stable sign across blocks
next_round_handoff.source_commit_for_next_round: the screening commit plus append-only result ledger

checkpoint_policy.caution: selective candidate-QK-block checkpoint from 0001 is excluded
checkpoint_policy.evidence_basis: experiment 0000 used exact Gram-only SAC; selective projection-only recomputation is a separate memory/runtime hypothesis; prior chunked-state failures are not evidence for this isolated policy

dx_gemm_backend.caution: same operands, shapes, layouts, and accumulation contract
dx_gemm_backend.evidence_basis: full-shape projection/GEMM traffic and exact N64 fused tile evidence

dy_gemm_backend.caution: Dy is exact; only backend/launch representation may change
dy_gemm_backend.evidence_basis: projection and pointwise materialization are measured costs

dy_relu_epilogue_layout.caution: component evidence is not an end-to-end TPS claim
dy_relu_epilogue_layout.evidence_basis: component diagnostic measured materialized neuron 53.947 ms, fused pointwise 25.119 ms, compiled 15.805 ms

e_gemm.caution: do not use FP4, quantization, or an approximate E operator
e_gemm.evidence_basis: native SM120 GEMM is an explicit hardware hypothesis; no clean isolated E result yet

full_symmetric_qk_sm120.caution: full strict-lower same-document Q=K only; blocked-prefix read is excluded
full_symmetric_qk_sm120.evidence_basis: attention is a measured dominant component; exact attention probes passed

qk_backward.caution: must accumulate query and key roles into one exact Q gradient
qk_backward.evidence_basis: tied-QK gradient is an invariant and attention backward is a measured cost center

randomization.control_interleave: anchor before each block, after every two candidate slots, plus block-end anchor and randomized control row G0-00
